decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s established market-data and analysis capabilities, and its continued own-page presence signals strong fit and learnable early results.

Although related to the firm’s existing tariff-calculation knowledge, its reduced web presence from a page to a mention creates some uncertainty, but the firm’s absorptive capacity in this domain still favors keeping it while monitoring results.

As a tool that builds on the firm’s established geographic-data and calculation knowledge, it remains within the firm’s capacity to improve, so the firm is likely to keep it even with a lower-profile web mention.
